summary: template options: mode (quote octal), newline_sequence (\n, \r, \r\n), and output_encoding for the rendered file (source must be UTF-8).
questions: How do I render a template with Windows line endings?
How do I write a template output in a non-UTF-8 encoding?
How should I set file permissions on a templated file?

answer_card.title: template mode, newlines, encoding
answer_card.answer_md:
- `mode`: quote octal (`'0644'`) or symbolic
- `newline_sequence`: `\n` (default), `\r`, `\r\n`
- `output_encoding` (utf-8): output encoding; the source template must be UTF-8
